picker.heading: Find a color
picker.drag: Drag to adjust saturation and brightness
picker.help: Choose a MARD match to use it.

app.name: My Beads
app.tagline: A little color. One bead at a time.
app.canvasHelp: Hold Space and drag to pan · Pinch to zoom · Arrow keys + Enter to edit · Shift + arrows to pan · ? for shortcuts
app.footer: Made for the joy of making.

keyboard.heading: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboard.scope: Shortcuts work in the editor. Text fields, input composition and dialogs keep their normal keys. Focus the canvas for arrow keys and Enter.
keyboard.highlightNote: Shift + 2 fits all locations of the highlighted color. Choose a color locator first. Space pans; Enter applies the current tool.

palette.heading: Your palette
palette.usedHelp: Choose a color to draw. Use the locator to highlight its beads.
palette.noUsed: No beads yet. Choose All colors to start drawing.

closest.label: Closest color
closest.description: Smallest color difference across the full palette, including grays.

chroma.label: Preserve chroma
chroma.description: Favors tinted colors over neutral grays when the input has a tint.

create.heading: Create a pattern
create.intro: Start with a blank canvas, a CSV pattern, or an image. Then make it yours, one bead at a time.
create.blankDescription: An empty grid, ready for your ideas. Choose how many beads fit across and down.
create.sizeHelp: 1–256 cells per side · One cell, one bead
create.csvDescription: Pick up an existing pattern with its original dimensions, colors, and empty cells.
create.csvDetail: CSV or TSV · MARD codes or exact hex colors · Up to 2 MB · Original grid and colors
create.imageDescription: Turn an image into a bead pattern. Preview the grid and choose how many bead colors to use.
create.imageDetail: PNG, WebP or JPEG · Up to 10 MB · Adjustable grid and bead-color limit
create.local: Your files stay on this device. All patterns use MARD 221.
create.keepCurrent: Your current pattern stays here until a new one is created. Export a copy if you want to keep both.

export.english: Chart labels are in English. Your pattern title is kept as entered.

descriptions.csv: Keep every color code and empty cell in a file you can edit again.
descriptions.pixel: A transparent PNG with crisp, square pixels. Choose how much to enlarge each cell.
descriptions.svg: A printable chart with cell codes, coordinates, and a color legend. Scales without losing sharpness.
descriptions.chart: The same labeled chart as a PNG, ready to save or print.

export.heading: Export pattern

draft.automatic: Drafts save automatically on this device.
draft.recoveryFailed: Draft recovery failed: {{detail}} Saving is paused; download your work or replace the saved draft.
draft.saveFailed: Draft could not be saved. Storage may be unavailable or full. Download your work to keep it.

image.heading: IMPORT IMAGE
image.intro: Choose a grid and a color limit to turn your image into a bead pattern. Use Preserve pixels for pixel artwork.
image.settingsHelp: Preview updates automatically. Ordinary images blend each cell’s source area; Preserve pixels samples its center. Pixel-mode manual choices are retained while their source colors remain. Transparent cells stay empty.
image.mappingHelp: Choose a MARD code for each source color. Clear an override to use automatic matching.
image.budgetHelp: Use up to 221 MARD colors. A smaller limit simplifies supplies; the result may use fewer colors.
image.mappingLimit: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} source colors. Search by hex to refine the list.
